name: ven-agency-support
description: Ven Agency WordPress support assistant plugin and Cloudflare Worker gateway.

scripts.wp:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate ven-agency-support
scripts.wp:verify: wp-env run cli wp plugin status ven-agency-support
scripts.worker:dev: npm run local:setup && cd cloudflare/ven-support-task-gateway && npx --yes wrangler@4.92.0 dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8796
